missing_from_story: The actual content of PR #7650 — whether it fixed merged-net tracking in incremental groute, refreshed the congestion report on net deletion, or both, since the thread leaves this unresolved.
A re-run congestion report or DRC count confirming the stale-net marker no longer appears after the fix.
Whether the separately promised follow-up ('update the congestion report when a net is deleted') was implemented, tracked, or left open in a new issue.

most_defensible_part: The hypothesis field, which records two independently attributed, mechanistically specific explanations (povik on merged-net handling in incremental groute; eder-matheus on the stale heatmap reference) without conflating them into a single vague cause.
